avis.titre: Not what I was looking for
avis.texte: I was originally looking for a color adjusting foundation, but this one was brought to my attention and I tried it in the store. It felt very nice on my skin, the colors were limited, but the darkest one is what worked best for my tan. It is a sheer coverage so the color blended in nicely but never really felt "dry" - so it had a residual feel to it, probably the SPF? The issue I had with this was only because I had a reaction near my eyes. I'm thinking that because it didn't dry, as time went on, it seeped closer to my eyes via my wrinkles and just irritated my eyes. I washed my face off before noon. I tried again one more day with a lighter amount, and still had the same reaction. If it wasn't for the reaction I had, this product would have been perfectly fine and I would still recommend to others. I am still on the hunt for something with SPF in it that I can wear without this irritation. I've never had issues with foundations (liquid or powder), and haven't typically worn SPF infused products - only started due to the other skin care items I use how that have retinoids.
